design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.u_implementation: alpha_final pooling written as (1-u)*mean_j h_j + u*sum_j alpha_j h_j (algebraically identical by linearity) so that u = 0 reproduces the C-native mean path BITWISE and u = 1 the R27-Q weighted path bitwise (R27-Q could only reach float tolerance with alpha = 1/5).
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.r_readout: softmax((16/a) g) computed as softmax(16 s + (16/a) r): the constant 16 b / a cancels in the softmax; with r = 0 this is the Q1 expression 16*s bitwise.
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.anchor_rule: the 'common low-capacity scalar calibration' for g0 = a s + b is the balanced logistic (Platt-type) loss with logit 2 g0 on the stage fit P and its FULL empirical product grid incl. the diagonal (convex; the diagonal in both P and Q keeps the optimum finite). Both VCS and BCE share the nonparametric optimum g* = 0.5 log(p/q); a logistic fit is the standard scalar estimator of that and is used for both arms. Note: the anchor objective coincides with R2's residual objective, not with R1's; this is the one asymmetry of the shared anchor and is disclosed.
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.anchor_fallback: a < A_MIN = 1 (beta > 16), non-finite or non-converged Newton -> residual off for that stage (alpha_score = softmax(16 s), exactly G1), counted rstage_aff_fallback.
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.u_features: best teacher cosine among the 5 candidates (R27-Q teacher coordinates), overlap of the A/B route unique top-5 lists, A/B top-1 agreement; + intercept. Not alpha max / entropy.
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.calibration_rows: stage P rows not used by the head fit/held-out sets, observed-image groups split in halves (fit / report), up to 4096 / 2048 rows. Query for the calibration search = the caption re-encoded by the teacher (unaugmented, chunk-centered; = the scoring coordinate), whereas the production application search query is the native loader xt2 (token augmentation, batch-centered). Disclosed difference of the calibration distribution.
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.own_record_exclusion: applied in calibration only (design: exclude the direct copy channel when the candidate record is the query's own queue record); implemented with unique_topk's source-ID exclusion on slot caption IDs in both routes. Application candidates are the unchanged production C_mix.
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.u_fallback: intercept-only logistic (weak-label rate; 0 or 1 if a class is empty) when a class has < 64 calibration-fit rows or the fit fails. The first co-train stage after the common prefix (teacher queue without IDs) necessarily hits this (u = 0 there, and that stage has no t2i rows anyway).
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.hard_candidate_log: per stage on the head held-out P: observed + 4 nearest distinct observed images (the R27-Q trial calibration construction); top-1/rank/NLL for cos and the arm readout.
design_choices_not_fixed_by_the_design.budget: STEPS 200, LR 1e-3, batch 128, hidden 256 inherited from R27-Q and asserted equal; no trial run, no change of steps.
